verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a game and rendering engine, so an official on-device ML inference runtime is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents rendering, physics, GUI, XR, audio and tooling, but nothing about running ML models. WebGPU support is a host-platform/graphics capability, not an inference runtime, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
